# draft2craift

> Local-first AI writing studio for LLM-assisted document writing with RAG. No cloud, no subscriptions.

The name is an acronym: **D**ocument **R**etrieval **A**ugmented **F**ile **T**ool **2** **C**ollaboratively **R**evised **A**I **F**ormatted **T**ext

## What is draft2craift?

draft2craift is an open-source desktop application (Python / PySide6) that combines a
Markdown editor, a local LLM chat interface, and a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
pipeline into a single offline-capable tool. All inference runs locally via GGUF models
through llama-cpp-python. No data leaves the machine.

## Who is it for?

- Researchers and writers who work with large collections of documents
- Anyone who wants AI writing assistance without sending data to the cloud
- Developers and power users who want full control over their LLM setup
- Companies with data privacy requirements (AGPL-3.0, self-hosted)

## Key capabilities

- Import PDF, DOCX, HTML, ODT, CSV, and code files into a local knowledge base
- Retrieve relevant passages automatically while writing (RAG)
- Chat with a local GGUF model (Llama, Mistral, Phi, Gemma, Qwen, etc.)
- Fact-check draft text against imported documents
- Edit prompts, save projects, run offline

## How does it differ from similar tools?

- vs. LM Studio: draft2craift focuses on document-grounded writing, not model management
- vs. OpenWebUI: desktop-native, no server required, integrated Markdown editor
- vs. Obsidian + AI plugins: built-in local inference, no API key needed
- vs. Jan.ai: includes a full RAG pipeline and document import with PDF processing
- vs. AnythingLLM: desktop app with a tighter editor-chat-RAG integration

## Technical details

- Language: Python 3.10+
- GUI: PySide6 (Qt6)
- Inference: llama-cpp-python (GGUF, supports CPU / CUDA / Metal)
- RAG: TF-IDF (built-in) or sentence-transformers (optional)
- PDF: pymupdf4llm (optional, AGPL-3.0)
- License: AGPL-3.0
- Platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS
